title: Tsukuyomi
body:
Syntax: perform tsukuyomi <target>

Description: Mangekyo technique that brings caster and target into a shared torture room. The target is frozen and cannot attack, cast jutsu, move, or use staff actions, even as an immortal; existing fights and queued casts stop. The caster's actions are: stab 150-250 Health; impale 300-450 Health (two actions); burn 100-200 Health plus 70-110 Stamina drain; crush 400-600 Health (25% early end); unmake drains 100-150 Stamina and Chakra with no direct Health damage. The ordeal lasts a hidden 5-10 actions. Once complete, the victim survives at up to 5% Health and zero Stamina. If either player disconnects, the illusion ends and both return. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. The target must be in your room; moving away before a delayed cast resolves makes it fizzle. Costs 65 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 90 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
